url.label: Server
url.description: The url of the Jellyfin server to connect to.

username.label: [%key:common::config_entries::username::label%]
username.description: The username to authenticate to the remote server. For example 'media'.

user.title: Connect to Jellyfin
user.description: Enter your Jellyfin server address and choose how Music Assistant should authenticate. Quick Connect avoids storing your Jellyfin password and is recommended when the server supports it.

password.title: Sign in to Jellyfin
password.description: Enter the Jellyfin username and password Music Assistant should use.

quick_connect.title: Approve Music Assistant in Jellyfin
quick_connect.description:
Your Quick Connect code is **{0}**.

Open **{1}** in Jellyfin and enter this code. Music Assistant will continue automatically after you approve it.

errors.quick_connect_expired: The Quick Connect request expired before it was approved. Please try again.
errors.quick_connect_failed: Quick Connect could not be completed. Check that Quick Connect is enabled on the Jellyfin server, then try again or use username and password.

manifest.description: Stream music from your self-hosted Jellyfin server.
